title: Universally fixed points of an internal scheme group action
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $R$ be a group object in schemes over $S$ (the relative form of [def-sc-group-scheme]), and let $X$ be an $S$-scheme with an $R$-action $a:R\times_S X\to X$ satisfying the unit and associativity identities. For an $S$-scheme $U$, define the set of universally fixed points to consist of $x:U\to X$ such that, for every $S$-scheme $V$, every $f:V\to U$, and every $t:V\to R$, one has $a(t,x\circ f)=x\circ f$. This specifies the fixed subfunctor on all test schemes, including nonreduced ones. No representability, affineness, smoothness, field or nonemptiness condition is imposed.
